integrity: The exact all-dimension scalar identity is proved by Schur specialization and a three-column dual Jacobi--Trudi determinant; finite code independently checks polynomial coefficients and exact low-dimensional boundaries.
scientific_limitations: Only one nontrivial isotypic sector is classified for all dimensions. The exact rank in \(n=7\) uses an exhaustive finite character table; no full rank formula for \(n\ge8\) or in general odd characteristic is asserted.
title: An exact Specht resonance in binary Fourier sampling on permutation matrices
